checks: OSC 133 metadata, exit codes, bounded command output and command CLI agree with the real PTY
real search keys find off-screen retained output, highlight it, navigate matches and copy UTF-8 selection without PTY input
Alt+C toggles search case; forward/backward navigation and clipboard preserve original spelling without PTY input
command navigation copies the selected first and second command regions through the real clipboard
filtered command palette executes a font action, font reset restores the grid and both preserve the running PTY
custom key and mouse bindings execute actions; application mouse reporting receives neither bound press nor release
width reflow preserves command IDs, exit codes and complete UTF-8 output; navigation copies both retained command regions
atomic config saves update pixels/font without restarting; explicit truecolor survives theme change; malformed reload retains the previous valid state
config watching recovers after the containing directory is renamed or deleted and recreated
history shows a temporary return control; new PTY output preserves the inspected rows and marks new output; clicking returns live, clears the indication and sends no application mouse bytes
the return control avoids search and palette rows; clicking preserves both modal input flows, clipboard search and the unchanged PTY grid
observing an already attached workspace pane preserves the other pane's actual X input focus
a read-only observer can return live after new output without acquiring input, resizing or replacing the PTY, or sending mouse input
closing an observer by action or WM_DELETE preserves the agent-owned PTY and permits reattachment
observers can inspect commands/search/copy while GUI typing and paste are blocked; explicit takeover restores input without restarting the PTY
same-owner local acquire leaves observation mode and restores real GUI input without replacing the PTY
attach --observe on an already attached local-owned view preserves the same live PTY when the observing window closes
a fresh --observe window owns and reaps only its newly created child when closed
launch waiter exits and session/PTY resources are released
